Risk: An authoritative hint replaces causal reasoning.
Safeguard: Present the hint as a question; require a learner justification before adding a link; provide reject and revise controls.
Evidence_to_collect: Prompt version, accept/reject action, learner justification, and diagram revision
Local_decision: When a hint may be offered and which tasks must be completed independently

Risk: An AI-suggested parameter or policy is accepted without testing.
Safeguard: Offer a counterfactual experiment; require a predicted outcome before simulation; preserve manual parameter control.
Evidence_to_collect: Prediction, selected parameters, simulation trace, and learner explanation
Local_decision: Permitted assistance during assessed modelling tasks

Risk: Feedback asserts a spurious causal link or wrong loop polarity.
Safeguard: Check guidance against an instructor-reviewed causal example set; flag unsupported links for review.
Evidence_to_collect: Annotated link judgements, failure examples, and reproducible prompt/model versions
Local_decision: Acceptable error and escalation criteria for open-ended causal explanations

Risk: A plausible explanation masks a unit, conservation, or numerical error.
Safeguard: Check units and water balance; test extreme inputs and repeated runs; provide a non-AI fallback.
Evidence_to_collect: Unit and balance checks, boundary-case outputs, seeds, and model versions
Local_decision: Numerical tolerances and conditions requiring the guidance function to stop

Risk: Transport discussion or logs expose identifiable learner information.
Safeguard: Use public or synthetic cases; pseudonymise diagrams; omit precise home-location data; restrict log access.
Responsible_actor: Institutional data steward and course lead
Evidence_to_collect: Data inventory, access record, deletion schedule, and rights procedure
Local_decision: Retention period, lawful processing basis, and permitted access roles

Risk: Rich interaction logs or uploaded files reveal identities or restricted data.
Safeguard: Use open or synthetic series; minimise learner identifiers; separate identity keys from model logs.
Responsible_actor: Institutional data steward and course lead
Evidence_to_collect: Data provenance, access permissions, model-file checks, and deletion record
Local_decision: Permitted data sources and retention/access rules

Risk: Learners cannot identify the assumption behind a suggested link.
Safeguard: Show the suggested causal relation, its assumed direction, and a plausible alternative interpretation.
Evidence_to_collect: Visible explanation, stated assumptions, source/provenance when available, and learner comprehension task

Risk: Guidance hides parameter assumptions or simulation limitations.
Safeguard: Show affected parameters, units, assumptions, and the conditions under which the advice may fail.
Evidence_to_collect: Parameter-level explanation, model provenance, and learner explanation task
Local_decision: Required technical detail and uncertainty presentation

Risk: Feedback privileges one travel perspective or an inaccessible diagram format.
Safeguard: Include commuter and accessibility perspectives; permit equivalent text descriptions; review feedback across alternative explanations.
Evidence_to_collect: Accessible task versions and feedback review across contrasted perspectives
Local_decision: Relevant learner needs and locally affected stakeholder perspectives

Risk: Guidance favours a single user group or one interaction modality.
Safeguard: Compare domestic, agricultural, and ecological water demands; offer accessible parameter-entry and output formats.
Evidence_to_collect: Accessible interface check and feedback review across allocation scenarios
Local_decision: Locally relevant users, access needs, and appropriate equity criteria

Risk: A short-term congestion improvement hides rebound or exclusion effects.
Safeguard: Prompt learners to inspect delayed travel responses and who benefits or loses; limit unnecessary AI calls.
Evidence_to_collect: Revised feedback-loop account, distributional reflection, and service-use record
Local_decision: Relevant time horizon, affected groups, and resource-use objectives

Risk: A short-term allocation gain hides ecological loss or delayed depletion.
Safeguard: Ask learners to test delayed storage and ecological consequences; record computational resource use.
Evidence_to_collect: Long-horizon simulation, allocation reflection, and service-use record
Local_decision: Ecological constraints, evaluation horizon, and resource-use objectives

Risk: Incorrect guidance cannot be reconstructed or escalated.
Safeguard: Version guidance and learner revisions; assign an educator to review flagged links and record corrective action.
Responsible_actor: Course lead and institutional AI owner
Evidence_to_collect: Versioned incident record, review decision, and corrected guidance
Local_decision: Review deadlines and authority to suspend or revise guidance

Risk: A misleading recommendation persists without a responsible reviewer.
Safeguard: Record model/prompt/parameter versions; route flagged advice to a domain reviewer; document decisions to change or pause use.
Responsible_actor: Course lead and institutional AI owner
Evidence_to_collect: Reproducible incident, assigned reviewer, decision record, and revised configuration
Local_decision: Review deadlines and authority to suspend or revise guidance
